title: [mime-tree] Add missing test coverage
description:
Skoll test gap findings:

- LOW-13: Add tests for decode_body_value InvalidRange: (1) offset+length overflows usize, (2) offset+length > raw.len()

close_reason: Added 7 integration tests: NoHeaders, InvalidRange overflow, InvalidRange past-end, multipart/related image first child, preview text/plain, preview binary-only, preview 256-char truncation.
